title: Concert recap: At 75, Basil Valdez proves enduring appeal of his OPM hits
summary: OPM icon Basil Valdez celebrated his 75th birthday with a full-length concert, “Salamin ng Buhay,” at the Maybank Performing Arts Theater of BGC Arts Center.
